stories.headline: Greenpanel: domestic MDF volume +12% while total volume fell 2.3% as exports hit zero
stories.instagram_caption:
Greenpanel's domestic MDF volumes grew 12% YoY this quarter.
Total MDF volumes still fell 2.3% YoY, as exports collapsed to zero amid Middle East disruption.
Most of the company's 15% price hike has been rolled back; management admitted losing market share to Century for two consecutive quarters.
Management again declined to give forward guidance.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: GREENPANEL — Q1 FY27]
Greenpanel's domestic MDF volumes grew 12% year-on-year this quarter.
[ON-SCREEN: Domestic volume: +12% | Total volume: -2.3%]
But total MDF volumes still fell 2.3%, because exports collapsed to zero on Middle East disruption.
[ON-SCREEN: 15% price hike — mostly rolled back]
Management also disclosed that most of an earlier 15% price hike has now been rolled back.
[ON-SCREEN: Admitted losing share to Century — 2 straight quarters]
The company admitted losing market share to Century for two consecutive quarters, despite the pricing move.
[ON-SCREEN: Forward guidance: again declined]
Management again declined to give specific forward guidance, citing plans to ramp domestic volumes over the remaining nine months of the year.
[ON-SCREEN: Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.]

stories.headline: Electrosteel Castings cuts FY27 volume guidance to 575,000 tons from 700,000-ton target
stories.instagram_caption:
Electrosteel Castings had targeted 700,000 tons of volume for FY27.
That guidance has now been revised down to 575,000 tons.
Margin recovery, earlier expected across the full year at 13-14%, is now expected only in the second half.
Management described the current domestic demand trough as cyclical, not structural.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: ELECTROSTEEL CASTINGS — Q1 FY27]
Electrosteel Castings had targeted 700,000 tons of volume for FY27.
[ON-SCREEN: Volume guidance: 700,000 tons -> 575,000 tons]
That target has now been cut to 575,000 tons.
[ON-SCREEN: Margin recovery: full-year 13-14% -> H2 only]
Margin recovery, earlier expected across the full year at 13 to 14%, is now expected only in the second half.
[ON-SCREEN: Paint business target raised: Rs 800-1,000 Cr]
Separately, the company's paint business target was raised, to Rs 800 to 1,000 crore.
[ON-SCREEN: Management: current trough 'cyclical, not structural']
Management said domestic demand remains depressed but described the current trough as cyclical, not structural.

stories.headline: IMFA posts record Q1 profit, then cuts FY27 volume guidance to 380,000 tons from 400,000
stories.instagram_caption:
Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys posted a record Q1: 80,000 tons sold at ~INR120,000/ton realization, its highest-ever quarterly revenue and profit.
In the same call, FY27 volume guidance was reduced to 380,000 tons, down from the prior 400,000-ton target.
Management attributed the cut to transformer replacements and emissions-control work at its KNR-2 plant.
KNR-1's first furnace tapping is imminent, with a full 50% volume uplift still expected by Q4 FY27.
Factual summary of public company disclosures. Not investment advice.
stories.youtube_shorts_script:
[ON-SCREEN: IMFA — Q1 FY27]
Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys posted a record quarter: 80,000 tons sold, at a realization of about 120,000 rupees per ton — its highest-ever quarterly revenue and profit.
[ON-SCREEN: FY27 volume guidance: 400,000T -> 380,000T]
But in the same call, management cut its FY27 volume guidance, to 380,000 tons from a prior 400,000-ton target.
[ON-SCREEN: Why: transformer replacement, emissions work at KNR-2]
The reduction was attributed to transformer replacements and emissions-control work at the company's KNR-2 plant.
[ON-SCREEN: KNR-1: first furnace tapping imminent]
Management said KNR-1's first furnace tapping is imminent, with a full 50% volume uplift still expected by Q4 FY27.
